question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a yellow present, Bob has a white present, Claire has a blue present, Dave has a silver present, Eve has a grey present, Fred has a black present, and Gertrude has a purple present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Dave and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Dave and Gertrude swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) yellow present
(B) white present
(C) blue present
(D) silver present
(E) grey present
(F) black present
(G) purple present
solution:
Each row lists present colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: yellow | white | blue | silver | grey | black | purple
1. Dave ↔ Bob: yellow | silver | blue | white | grey | black | purple
2. Dave ↔ Alice: white | silver | blue | yellow | grey | black | purple
3. Alice ↔ Eve: grey | silver | blue | yellow | white | black | purple
4. Dave ↔ Bob: grey | yellow | blue | silver | white | black | purple
5. Dave ↔ Alice: silver | yellow | blue | grey | white | black | purple
6. Claire ↔ Alice: blue | yellow | silver | grey | white | black | purple
7. Dave ↔ Gertrude: blue | yellow | silver | purple | white | black | grey
Claire has the silver present, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
